subject: 970 Fellsway Chapter 40B Permit
overview: The board considered a procedural request regarding a proposed 289-unit development at 970 Fellsway. The public hearing was continued to March 14, 2024, to allow for the review of a traffic study.

items.title: 970 Fellsway Comprehensive Permit Application
items.summary: The board granted a request to continue the Chapter 40B comprehensive permit hearing for a 289-unit development at 970 Fellsway to March 14, 2024, in order to allow time to complete and review a traffic study.
